text.tspan: THE FIX ISN'T A DOCKER-COMPOSE UPGRADE (V1 IS DEAD) - IT'S
SIDESTEPPING THE RECREATE CODE PATH ENTIRELY. DELETING THE
STALE CONTAINER (NOT ITS VOLUMES) MAKES THE NEXT UP A PLAIN
CREATE, WHICH NEVER TOUCHES GET_CONTAINER_DATA_VOLUMES. SAFE
TO REPEAT ANY TIME THIS SPECIFIC ERROR RESURFACES.
